notes: 1. All 7 desktop icons use different chunky pixel-art graphics and metaphors instead of the target's mixed Win95/vector icons (e.g., Doomguy bust vs Cacodemon, overlapping speech bubbles vs white rounded tile with Gemini star, artist palette vs paint window, single mine vs numbered minesweeper grid window, spiral notebook vs gray notepad window, flat monitor vs isometric CRT, pixelated vs smooth Chrome). 2. The taskbar adds a recessed system tray on the far right with a volume icon and clock ('1:07 PM') that is completely absent in the target. 4. The horizontal spacing between the 7 top-row desktop icons is noticeably tighter in the regeneration (ending around 56% of viewport width vs ~64% in the target). 5. Desktop icon labels in the regeneration have a heavier dark drop shadow compared to the cleaner white labels in the target.
